IAR Systems supplies future-proof software tools and services for embedded development, enabling companies worldwide to create the products of today and the innovations of tomorrow. Since 1983, IAR Systems' solutions have ensured quality, reliability and efficiency in the development of over one million embedded applications. The complete C/C++ compiler and debugger toolchain, IAR Embedded Workbench, offers full-scale support for Microchip's 8- and 32-bit AVR MCUs as well as Microchip's ARM-based and 8051-based MCUs families.





See at their booth...


IAR Embedded Trust: PIC32CM LS00 Curiosity Pro Kit
Experience end-to-end device security built on a hardware Root of Trust. This demo highlights secure boot, authenticated updates, and robust lifecycle management for defense against malware, rollback attacks, and tampering, using a device-agnostic architecture that streamlines security integration across MCUs.

IAR Secure Deploy: PIC32CM LS00 Curiosity Pro Kit
Discover ho to safeguard the journey from prototype to mass production. This demo showcases secure manufacturing integrity using encrypted production packages and hardware security modules (HMSs) to prevent IP theft, cloning, and overproduction while ensuring compliance with global standards like ETSI EN 303 645 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

IAR Systems supplies future-proof software tools and services for embedded development, enabling companies worldwide to create the products of today and the innovations of tomorrow. Since 1983, IAR Systems' solutions have ensured quality, reliability and efficiency in the development of over one million embedded applications. The complete C/C++ compiler and debugger toolchain, IAR Embedded Workbench, offers full-scale support for Microchip's 8- and 32-bit AVR MCUs as well as Microchip's ARM-based and 8051-based MCUs families.
Visit them at booth 5502!

MIKROE is proud to partner with Microchip Technology, a global leader in smart, connected, and secure embedded control solutions. Through this collaboration, we integrate Microchip’s microcontrollers, digital signal controllers, and peripherals into a wide range of our products - enabling engineers to streamline development and bring ideas to life faster.

To complete your development workflow, we supply high-performance programmers and debuggers, fully compatible with Microchip-based platforms. Plus, our intuitive smart display solutions - available in sizes from 2.8” to 5” - empower users to create engaging graphical interfaces powered by Microchip MCUs. Whether you’re developing industrial, automotive, or consumer applications, MIKROE and Microchip Technology together offer the tools and technology you need to innovate with confidence.

For more than three decades, SEGGER has empowered embedded engineers with reliable software and a comprehensive suite of development tools. From the creation of the first line of code to the final stages of production, SEGGER products are trusted by developers around the globe. SEGGER: It simply works!
Visit them at booth 6514!

Siemens Digital Industries Software (DISW) is a business unit within Siemens Digital Industries that provides digital transformation software, services, and solutions. We specialize in Electronic Design Automation (EDA), Computer-Aided Design (CAD), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Computer-Aided Manufacturing (CAM), and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) solutions.

props.text: Stop by the TASKING booth to see demonstrations of our latest Safety Critical Debug and Test workflows for applications running on Microchip SAM V71 and PolarFire RISC-V devices.  The workflows include Static and Dynamic Analysis along with Timing and Coverage Analysis needed to satisfy up to DO-178C DAL-A or ISO 26262 ASIL-D requirements. You can also see a preview of our AI-assisted Solutions that can further accelerate software development and certification.

spans.text: TASKING

is a leading provider of embedded software development tools that compile, debug and test. These tools enable embedded software engineers to develop reliable, high-performance applications for a safer future. Founded in 1977,
TASKING
is committed to expanding its portfolio to deliver a single-supplier, certifiable toolchain. As a trusted partner focused on customer need, expertise and a commitment to sustainability,
TASKING

and its integrated toolchain accelerates the software development lifecycle for safety and security critical applications in industries such as automotive, aerospace and defense, industrial, medical, robotics and others.

Founded in 1979, Lauterbach GmbH develops the advanced TRACE32 product line, the industry-leading debug and trace tools for embedded systems used across automotive, aerospace, medical, and other critical domains worldwide. They support over 1000 different Microchip devices (ARM7/9/v7-A/R/Cortex-M; AVR8/32; dsPIC DSCs; MIPS32/64; MPC60x/75x; RISC-V 32/64

Percepio is a leading provider of observability tools for embedded software development. Our solutions help developers visualize and analyze real-time behavior in embedded systems, improving reliability, performance, and time-to-market. Percepio tools support popular RTOS platforms and are trusted by engineers in aerospace, automotive, industrial, and IoT applications.

Percepio offers observability for critical edge software throughout the product lifecycle, enabling OEMs and operators to develop and deploy intelligent systems with confidence.We build our products under the concept of Continuous Observability.

wolfSSL focuses on creating high quality, portable, embedded security software.  Current products include the wolfSSL embedded TLS library (with OpenSSL compatibility layer), wolfCrypt embedded crypto engine, wolfMQTT, wolfSSH, wolfTPM, wolfBoot, wolfSentry, wolfEngine, wolfProvider, curl/tinycurl, wolfSSL’s Java JSSE/JCE providers, and wolfHSM. As strong believers in open source, the majority of wolfSSL’s products are dual licensed under both the GPLv3 as well as standard commercial licensing.
Visit them at booth 6027!

Embedd builds AI-powered Digital Twins of chip hardware and uses them to deterministically generate production-ready drivers. See Zephyr enablement running live on a Microchip board, then see the same Digital Twin drive a virtual model of that silicon, so firmware can be developed and tested before boards or samples are in hand.

Arm provides the industry's most efficient and highest-performing compute platform, with more than 310 billion Arm-based chips shipped to date. Arm Keil tools provide solutions for building and debugging embedded applications on Cortex-M based systems.
Arm Keil MDK is the most comprehensive software development solution for Arm-based microcontrollers and includes all components that you need to create, build, and debug embedded applications.

CPPcheck Solutions AB was founded in 2021 by Daniel Marjamaki together with Par Jelger and Magnus Janagard. CPPcheck Solutions maintains the CPP check open-source repository as well as markets and sells the commercial tool CPPcheck Premium.
CPPcheck Solutions is committed to contribute to and grow the Open-Source community and ensure that the open-source version will continue to be free and available for everyone to use.

Green Hills Software's technology and services have been chosen by prominent companies in over 50 countries to build their electronic products for everything from MP3 players to jumbo jets. Our open architecture integrated development solutions addressed deeply embedded, absolute security and high reliability applications for the military/avionics, medical, industrial, automotive, networking, consumer and other markets that demand industry-certified solutions.
Visit them at booth 6310!
PEmicro, founded in 1982, is a trend-setter in the embedded industry producing both in-circuit software development tools and production programmers while providing first class technical support.

PEmicro's production flash programmers come in both single-channel and multi-channel configurations and are high speed, highly parallel, secure and easy to use programmers. PEmicro's development tools include hardware debug pods that work with many popular development tool IDEs and support advanced features like SWO recording, power recording, semi-hosting, operating system awareness, secure JTAG, life-cycle management, test and more.
We are the measurement insight company committed to performance, and compelled by possibilities.

Tektronix solutions have supported many of humankind’s greatest advances of the past 70 years. Health. Communication. Mobility. Space. With offices in 21 countries, we are committed to the scientists, engineers and technicians around the world who will define the future.

props.text:
The Common Microcontroller Software Interface Standard (CMSIS) helps developers accelerate embedded development through code reuse, portability and interoperability across Arm® Cortex®-M and Cortex®-A devices. Standardized interfaces, software components and CMSIS-Packs simplify project setup and make it easier to migrate applications across devices and toolchains.
 
Microchip is leveraging the CMSIS-Toolbox- including its project management, software configuration and build capabilities—alongside CMSIS-DAP, Device Family Packs (DFPs) and Generic Software Packs (GSPs) to deliver a more consistent and flexible development experience. CMSIS-DAP support for hardware such as MPLAB® PICkit™ 5, MPLAB PICkit Basic and Curiosity boards enables connectivity with standard-compliant IDEs and toolchains without proprietary drivers or complex installations.
 
Together, these capabilities help developers streamline workflows, get from evaluation to production faster and build portable, future-ready embedded applications.

props.text:
Microchip zSDK is a framework that delivers a minimally customized Zephyr® distribution, with downstream modules and Microchip libraries. This will enable embedded teams to build, flash and debug production-ready applications on Microchip microcontrollers from one trusted starting point.

zSDK uses the Zephyr west meta-tool to orchestrate a curated set of repositories, each pinned to a tested revision in a top-level manifest. One workspace — mchp_zephyrproject — assembles everything you need.
